criteria.criterion: A drain test in crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs shows both passes (backfill and derivation) run at drain start and each prints a one-line summary; a second drain with no new records writes nothing (no new commit or records). Run: cargo test -p athena-cli drain.
criteria.evidence: Two tests cover this, and both passed when I ran them. The unit test in src/drain.rs, `a_drain_runs_the_review_passes_before_it_reads_the_queue_and_prints_a_line_for_each`, checks that the review passes run before the queue is read and that exactly one UI line is printed per pass. The integration test in tests/drain.rs, `a_drain_runs_the_backfill_and_the_derivation_at_its_start_and_a_second_drain_writes_nothing`, uses the real steps on a seeded repeated cause. The first drain queues 1 root-cause request and prints a backfill line and an evidence-labels line. The second drain prints 'queued 0 · re-queued 0 · priority set 0' and '0 derived', and the git head is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: A test in crates/athena-core/src/evidence_labels.rs shows a recurrence-after-prevention label is not rewritten on a rerun after more jobs have closed with otherwise unchanged evidence (derive returns no labels). Run: cargo test -p athena-core evidence_labels.
criteria.evidence: The test `a_stopped_after_prevention_label_is_not_rewritten_when_more_jobs_close` passed. It derives one label, closes 3 more jobs, and re-derives: the second derive returns no labels and counts 1 as already derived. Reading the old code, the old detail 'over {closed} jobs' would have changed from 5 to 8, so this test would fail without the fix.

criteria.criterion: A hestia.rs test shows a sweep runs the backfill and derivation and a repeat sweep over unchanged records changes nothing. Run: cargo test -p athena-core hestia.
criteria.evidence: The test `a_sweep_runs_the_backfill_and_the_derivation_and_a_repeat_sweep_changes_nothing_else` passed. The first sweep queues requests and prints 'backfill: 9 repeated' and 'evidence labels:'. The second sweep adds no requests and no labels, adds only the sweep report, and prints 2 lines.

criteria.criterion: The recurrence-after-prevention basis detail no longer contains the live count of closed jobs, so it is the same text whenever the evidence is the same.
criteria.evidence: In evidence_labels.rs (around line 285) the detail now reads 'did not recur over at least {STOPPED_MIN_JOBS} closed jobs'. The live `closed` count is now used only for the threshold check, so the cause is fixed where it originates rather than by removing duplicates afterwards.

criteria.criterion: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test all pass.
criteria.evidence: Athena's recorded checks for this tree: fmt passed, clippy with -D warnings passed, and cargo test passed (1426 tests).

criteria.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing automatic backfill and derivation at drain start and sweep, and the stable recurrence label, and noting that it supersedes request 20261026-224929-6erm.
criteria.evidence: There is a new entry under Added. It covers the automatic passes at drain start and in each sweep, the one-line summaries, idempotence, how a failing pass is reported, that the CLI commands stay available, the stable threshold-based basis, and 'This supersedes request 20261026-224929-6erm.'

criteria.criterion: Doc comments in hestia.rs and drain.rs that say a person runs athena hestia review --backfill or athena score-jev --derive are updated to say Athena runs them; the CLI commands stay available.
criteria.evidence: In hestia.rs, the module comment and the doc for error_review_backfill now say Athena runs the backfill at drain start and in each sweep, and that the command runs it on request. The doc on the new review_passes says the same. The new Steps::review_passes doc in drain.rs says no person has to run the commands. The doc for derive_labels and the hint in status.rs are updated too. The CLI commands are unchanged.

findings.summary: A file outside the expected deliverables list was changed: crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs.
findings.evidence: `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` lists main.rs, which is not on the deliverables list. The change is needed for the requested behaviour: `athena hestia sweep` now calls hestia_sweep_with(…, &Terminal), so the real sweep runs the passes. It is small and necessary, but it is outside the listed scope.

findings.summary: A crate-level doc comment still names only the manual derive command.
findings.evidence: It reads '`athena score-jev --derive` runs it;' and does not mention that Athena now runs the derivation at drain start and in each sweep. The file is outside the files named in criterion 7, so this is only an inconsistency for readers.

findings.summary: A re-queue during the automatic backfill can print extra lines besides the one-line summary.
findings.evidence: apply_step passes `ui` to self.close(...) when it re-queues, so a drain that re-queues a request can print close output in addition to the one summary line. On unchanged records nothing is re-queued, so the repeat-run tests are unaffected.

summary: Pass. The change does what was asked. Every `athena drain` now runs the error review backfill and the evidence-label derivation before it reads the queue. The real `athena hestia sweep` runs them too, through the new hestia_sweep_with call. Each pass prints one summary line, and a pass that fails is reported in its line without stopping the drain or sweep. The unstable recurrence label is fixed at its cause: the basis text now states the threshold (at least 5 closed jobs) instead of the live closed-job count. I ran the three targeted test commands myself in this snapshot, and all of the new tests passed. Those tests show the passes run at drain start and in a sweep, that a second drain or sweep over unchanged records writes nothing (git head and record counts unchanged), and that a recurrence-after-prevention label is not rewritten after more jobs close; the label test would fail on the old code. For fmt, clippy and the full test suite I relied on Athena's recorded results, which passed. The changelog entry is complete and names the superseded request. Closing that request is left to the landing process, as the reading assumed. Findings: one minor scope item (main.rs is outside the deliverables list, but the change is needed for the sweep wiring) and two nits.
